risks.proof: Close-up video of each port in use with cable connected and signal confirmed

proof_requests: Video of console powering on to the dashboard, showing storage settings
Close-up video of all ports in use with a cable/output test
Video of disc drive accepting and ejecting a disc
Photos of all sides of the console, including back and underside
Photo of full accessory bundle (cables, controllers, box if any)
Photo of the UK receipt next to the console
response.reason: The witness confirms this is an Xbox console with one controller, so it can be priced at worst case (unverified capacity, function, and accessories) while proof is requested to raise the price.
